description: This file declares the EnoughData class, which implements the IPlayerTask interface for handling 'enough data' events in a media player context. It includes references to GStreamer app source and a custom player context.

classes.name: EnoughData
classes.description: A class representing a task to handle the event when enough data has been buffered in the media player.

methods.name: EnoughData
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the task with a player context and a GStreamer app source.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the task, likely signaling that enough data has been buffered.
